anomalies.observed: C2 is labelled 100m, i.e. 100 mF, while the other servo-rail bulk capacitors C1, C3 and C4 are labelled 100u (100 µF).
anomalies.expected: All four servo-rail bulk capacitors are 100 µF per the specification.

evidence.quote: C1–C4 | 100 µF × 4 | Bulk capacitance on the servo power rail (downstream of D2), buffering the high inrush current of PWM servos.
C2 100m GND (sheet 1, servo power section, next to J3; the other three bulk caps read 100u)

anomalies.impact: A 100 mF capacitor is 1000× the intended value. It is physically far too large for the footprint and is a likely assembly or sourcing error. It would also make the +5V rail draw a very large charging surge when the board powers up, which can drop the M5Stack supply.

parsed.summary: C2 on the servo power rail is marked 100m (100 mF) while the spec and the three sibling bulk capacitors call for 100 µF, so the value is inconsistent with the design intent. The rest of the passives I checked (R3/R4 1k, R6 2k, R7 20k, R8/R15 2.2k, R5 47k, R9–R14 jumpers) match the spec.
